mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (above 8.0%) indicates a weak labor market and slowing economic activity, which suppresses corporate earnings growth and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 8.0% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in housing starts above 550,000 units signals strengthening consumer confidence and residential investment, which boosts economic growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST exceeds 550.0 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI inflation rate above 2.5% signals accelerating price pressures, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 3-month moving averages indicates broad-based consumer and business confidence, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST and RSAFS both above 3-month MA) fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (PAYEMS up and UNRATE down) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO below 100.0), manufacturing weakness signals an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below 100.0 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: During periods of monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and CPIAUCSL > 2.0%), the Federal Reserve's policy stance leads to higher discount rates and reduced equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and CPIAUCSL > 2.0% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).
